text:
alex: Quick sync — AtlasCloud asked for a cleaner oncall/handback flow after yesterday's noisy outage. They want a single source of truth for who runs the bridge and how handoffs work.
mina: saw that — they were pinging multiple folks and the warroom wasn't created with the right permissions. can we standardize? :face_with_rolling_eyes: 
chris: Proposal: 1) use a shared partner channel (#atlascloud-partners) for day-to-day, 2) create a temporary war room channel for SEVs like #war-<partner>-YYYYMMDD, 3) attach a pinned runbook and set limited invite perms.
alex: +1. Also need to clarify escalation ownership: partner support -> partner SE -> redwood oncall -> redwood eng lead. if partner SE is offline, fallback to marketplace-ops.
kevin: Important: who is allowed to create the warroom channel? suggest partner PM, Redwood partner-ops, or SRE lead. we should script it so the bot can auto-create with the right defaults.
partnerships-bot: Reminder: new war room template v2 is available. Use `/create-warroom atlascloud` to provision channel + bridge + pinned runbook. (bot)
lia: Love the bot idea — reduces human error. we should also auto-add the oncall rota and include the short escalation matrix in the channel topic.
mina: sample channel topic idea: "War room — AtlasCloud | RW oncall: @sre-oncall | Partner SE: @atlas-se | Escalation: RW Eng Lead after 30m"
chris: naming convention (code):
```
#war-<partner>-YYYYMMDD (e.g. #war-atlascloud-20261003)
```
and pinned runbook link.
alex: for handback I want a 3-step checklist pinned in the warroom: 1) Confirm partner triage complete, 2) Transfer ownership in incident tracker (link), 3) Schedule postmortem owner and invite list. can someone draft that?
mina: i'll draft the checklist and put it in the repo: https://git.internal/redwood/partner-oncall/runbooks (draft will be in /atlascloud/handback.md).
kevin: also add LR (lessons learned) tag to the postmortem so partner PM sees the followups.
lia: what about tooling — should SRE be able to add Redwood telemetry to partner dashboards temporarily? we need an access checklist for that.
chris: yes — add to runbook: temporary data buckets, retention, and audit owners. security signoff required before we add telemetry.
alex: timeline — mina, can you own the doc this week? we'll iterate with Atlas next Tue call.
mina: yes — i'll put a PR by Thu EOD.
kevin: i'll start a tiny lambda that wires `/create-warroom` into slack and adds the default pins. will share PR.
lia: thanks — once PRs land we'll run a tabletop with Atlas and simulate a 30m handback. :checkered_flag: 
partnerships-bot: Tabletop reminder set for 2026-10-08 17:00 UTC.
alex: perfect. last thing — who signs the handback? add fields to the checklist: partner_confirmed (yes/no), redwood_accept (name), timestamp.
mina: noted, adding those fields.
chris: I'll update the partner onboarding checklist so this flow is included for future marketplace SIs.
alex: great work team. short follow-up: please react with :white_check_mark: when you see the PRs so we can merge quickly.
mina: ✅
kevin: ✅
lia: ✅
chris: ✅
partnerships-bot: (automated) warroom template v2 used 0 times this week — encourage teams to try it.
